annotations.title: Hand a task to the shop (AI)

description: Hand a task for running a shop to its assistant — prices, discounts, stock, hiding or showing products, orders: 'all candles 20 % off until Sunday'. It checks the task against the real stock and returns proposed steps. Nothing changes yet: tell the user the proposal waits for their approval in the shop (review_path). Uses the AI quota. Shop ids come from list_shops.

instruction.description: The task, concrete and complete (4–1000 characters).
